realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12az / WP-S2c-17 uses the next prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, 2022-04-12 through 2023-04-11, as the second additional H-001 exp_success_criteria observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-001 REP-0002 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this package follows the later repo precedent of explicit non-cloned window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: EXP-0002 requires OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0019 records sharpe below that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires dsr_val > 0.95; OL-0019 records dsr below that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires max drawdown <= 20%; OL-0019 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0019 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL; OL-0019 records positive gross_pnl and cost_drag_fraction below that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0019 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.
